title.en: Australia politics live: Jane Hume attacks ‘hypocrisy’ of property tax reform as auction clearance rates fall below 50%
title.zh: 澳大利亚政治直播：简·休姆抨击房产税改革的“虚伪”，拍卖清盘率跌破50%

summary.en: Deputy Liberal leader Jane Hume criticized Labor politicians for "pulling the ladder up behind them" on property tax reform, arguing they used negative gearing to create wealth before proposing changes. This comes as auction clearance rates in Australia fall below 50%.
summary.zh: 自由党副领袖简·休姆批评工党政客在房产税改革问题上“过河拆桥”，称他们在利用负扣税创造财富后，现在却提议改变政策。与此同时，澳大利亚的房产拍卖清盘率已跌破50%。

body.en: Deputy Liberal leader says Labor politicians pulling the ladder up behind them after using negative gearing to create wealth. Follow today’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Hume has no problem with more debate on NDIS changes, but criticises ‘horse trading’ between Labor and the Greens Jane Hume is speaking to RN Breakfast now, saying the Coalition has no problem with increased scrutiny over changes to the NDIS should the Greens negotiate a longer inquiry into the scheme the week. I suppose one of our concerns is that perhaps the changes don’t go far enough in addressing the rorts and the criminal behaviour that we’ve seen embedded in the NDIS system now. We want to make sure that they are appropriately addressed. And we also want to make sure that Australia’s most vulnerable are well cared for. And there does seem to be some oversights in there. So I have no problems with scrutiny of legislation. It’s no surprise that the Greens have got into horse trading with Labor over this. We know exactly what it is that they do. This is their modus operandi. I think that speaks volumes of this Labor government’s priorities. Continue reading...
body.zh: 自由党副领袖表示，工党政客在利用负扣税创造财富后，把梯子拉到了他们身后。关注今天的新闻直播 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 休姆对关于 NDIS 变更的更多辩论没有问题，但批评工党和绿党之间的“讨价还价” 简·休姆现在在接受 RN Breakfast 采访时表示，如果绿党在本周就该计划进行更长时间的调查，联盟党对加强对 NDIS 变更的审查没有问题。我想我们担心的问题之一是，也许这些变化在解决我们现在看到的 NDIS 系统中嵌入的侵权行为和犯罪行为方面还远远不够。我们希望确保这些问题得到适当解决。我们还希望确保澳大利亚最弱势的群体得到良好的照顾。而且这里面似乎确实存在一些疏忽。所以我对立法审查没有任何问题。绿党因此与工党进行讨价还价也就不足为奇了。我们确切地知道他们在做什么。这就是他们的作案手法。我认为这充分说明了工党政府的优先事项。继续阅读...

Yahweh's word reminds us that building prosperity should not come at the expense of others' fair opportunity or through policies that create injustice. True leadership seeks to ensure equitable access and opportunity for...
reflection.zh: 在从某个制度中受益后却“过河拆桥”的指责，凸显了领导力和政策制定中的伦理挑战。雅伟的话语提醒我们，建立繁荣不应以牺牲他人公平机会或通过制造不公的政策为代价。真正的领导力旨在确保所有人都能获得平等的机会，而不是在确保自身优势的同时让其他人处于不利地位。

verse.textEn: Woe to him who builds his palace by unrighteousness, who makes his own people work for nothing.
verse.textZh: 那行不义盖房、行不公造楼、白白使用人的手工不给工价的有祸了！

title.en: First round of direct US-Iran talks since deal expected to continue through the night
title.zh: 美国和伊朗在瑞士开始初步和平协议谈判

summary.en: US and Iranian officials have begun face-to-face talks in Switzerland to negotiate an initial peace deal. This meeting follows recent fighting in Lebanon and Iran's claim to have closed the Strait of Hormuz.
summary.zh: 美国和伊朗官员已在瑞士开始面对面会谈，以谈判一项初步和平协议。此次会晤是在黎巴嫩持续冲突以及伊朗声称关闭霍尔木兹海峡之后进行的。

body.en:
Negotiations between the US and Iran to reach a final deal to end the war are expected to continue throughout the night in Switzerland, a senior US diplomat engaged in the talks said.

The US-Iran talks began on Sunday, after last week's agreement to reach a deal in 60 days.

Late Sunday night, the US diplomat said discussions were focused on "clarifying some of the confusing messaging from Iran" on the re-opening of the Strait of Hormuz, enforcing the ceasefire in southern Lebanon and "elements" of a nuclear deal.

Earlier, Trump had threatened to attack Iran if it did not stop Hezbollah amid continued clashes with Israel in Lebanon. Iran dismissed the warning, saying it was prepared to fight.

The US diplomat said both delegations, who are meeting in the Swiss city Lucerne, would use "today's work as a starting point for ongoing technical talks going forward".

Last week's initial agreement includes a commitment to reach a final deal within 60 days, as well as an end to fighting on "all fronts" - including in Lebanon - and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

However, there has since been an upsurge in fighting between Hezbollah and Israeli forces in southern Lebanon, and Israeli air strikes that the health ministry says have killed dozens of Lebanese including women and children.

That escalation led the US to declare a new ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah on Friday. Continued clashes and air strikes prompted Iran on Saturday to announce it had shut the Strait of Hormuz - though tracking data shows vessels have continued to pass through it.

As the talks in Lucerne between the US and Iranian delegations began, Trump posted that Iran "must immediately stop their highly paid PROXIES in Lebanon from causing trouble" and threatened to "hit Iran very hard again" if they did not.

Iran's lead negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf responded by saying: "Don't they think that if their threats had any effect, they wouldn't be in this desperate situation today?... No matter how much they talk, it is we who take action."

On Sunday, fighting was reported to have diminished but Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu insisted that the Israeli military would remain in southern Lebanon for as long as is necessary to protect northern Israel.

Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem has rejected any Israeli military presence in southern Lebanon and said Hezbollah would defend itself.

Speaking before the talks at the Swiss resort of Bürgenstock, US lead negotiator Vice-President JD Vance said Trump had asked negotiators to "turn over a new leaf".

He added that if Iran's leadership was willing to give up being a "driver of regional instability" and its "nuclear weapons ambitions for the longer term", then the US "is willing to fundamentally transform our...
body.zh: 上周签署结束战争的初步协议后，美国和伊朗官员在瑞士开始直接会谈。 该协议包括承诺在 60 天内达成最终协议，以及结束“所有战线”（包括黎巴嫩）的战斗以及重新开放霍尔木兹海峡。 但以色列和伊朗支持的黎巴嫩真主党之间发生的更多冲突促使伊朗宣布周六关闭了这条航线——尽管跟踪数据显示船只继续通过该航线。 会谈开始后，唐纳德·特朗普总统在社交媒体上表示，伊朗“必须立即停止其在黎巴嫩的高薪代理人制造麻烦”。 会谈开始前，副总统万斯曾表示，美国希望在“核问题”和黎巴嫩问题上取得进展，而德黑兰则表示将“要求对方履行承诺”。 在瑞士度假胜地布尔根施托克，万斯表示，特朗普已要求谈判代表“翻开新的一页”。他补充说，如果伊朗领导层愿意放弃成为“地区不稳定的推动者”和“长期的核武器野心”，那么美国“愿意从根本上改变我们与该国的关系”。 伊朗外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴卡伊(Esmaeil Baqaei)在一份声明中表示，最终协议的谈判取决于执行现有承诺，包括停止所有军事行动。他说，周日的会谈重点是实施。 特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳和特使史蒂夫·威特科夫也加入了万斯的行列。 对于伊朗人来说，议长穆罕默德·巴格尔·加利巴夫和外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇于周六晚抵达瑞士。 巴基斯坦总理谢赫巴兹·谢里夫和该国武装部队总司令阿西姆·穆尼尔元帅与代表团一起出席。 巴基斯坦在整个战争期间充当调解人，并主持了美国和伊朗之间的上一轮谈判。 美国和伊朗总统本周早些时候签署了初步协议，旨在立即结束战争。 根据协议，伊朗将重新开放霍尔木兹海峡，这是全球 20% 的石油和天然气运输的主要运输通道。它的有效关闭推高了燃油价格并扰乱了全球经济。 美国还同意解除对进出伊朗港口的船只的军事封锁。 最初的协议还包括一项价值3000亿美元（2240亿英镑）的伊朗“重建”计划，以及美国终止对其的“所有类型的制裁”。 但美国所说的冲突主要原因——伊朗核计划问题仍有待谈判。在特朗普的第一个任期内，他让美国退出了奥巴马时代与伊朗的核协议，并重新实施了经济制裁……

reflection.en: The start of peace talks between nations, even amidst ongoing tensions, reflects a vital step towards reconciliation. Yahweh blesses those who actively work for peace, recognizing their efforts to bridge divides and seek common ground. Such initiatives, though challenging, are essential for fostering understanding and reducing conflict.
reflection.zh: 即使在持续的紧张局势中，国家间和平谈判的开始也反映了迈向和解的重要一步。雅伟赐福那些积极促成和平的人，认可他们弥合分歧、寻求共同点的努力。这些举措虽然充满挑战，但对于促进理解和减少冲突至关重要。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: At least seven people killed in Chicago shootings as Trump renews military call
title.zh: 芝加哥枪击案致至少七人死亡，特朗普再次呼吁军队介入

summary.en: At least seven people have been killed and dozens injured in multiple shootings in Chicago since Friday. The city's mayor stated that "violence has no place in our city," while former President Trump criticized the governor for not accepting National Guard troops to address the situation.
summary.zh: 自上周五以来，芝加哥发生多起枪击事件，造成至少七人死亡，数十人受伤。该市市长表示“暴力在我们城市没有立足之地”，而前总统特朗普则批评州长不接受国民警卫队介入处理局势。

body.en: Mayor says ‘violence has no place in our city’ as president criticizes governor for not accepting national guard troops At least seven people have been killed and dozens injured in several shootings in Chicago since Friday, police said, with Donald Trump once again calling for military intervention in the midwestern city. In a post on Truth Social, Trump questioned why Illinois’s governor, JB Pritzker, had not welcomed military deployment. Continue reading...
body.zh: 市长称“暴力在我们的城市没有立足之地”，总统批评州长不接受国民警卫队 警方称，自周五以来，芝加哥发生多起枪击事件，已造成至少七人死亡、数十人受伤，唐纳德·特朗普再次呼吁对这座中西部城市进行军事干预。在《Truth Social》上发表的一篇文章中，特朗普质疑伊利诺伊州州长 JB Pritzker 为何不欢迎军事部署。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The tragic surge in violence in Chicago highlights a profound societal challenge, where the mechanisms of law and order appear strained. Habakkuk's lament, "So the law is paralyzed, and justice never goes forth," echoes the cry for effective protection and peace when communities are overwhelmed. In such times, we are called to seek Yahweh's wisdom and...
reflection.zh: 芝加哥暴力事件的悲剧性激增，凸显了一个深刻的社会挑战，法律和秩序的机制似乎已不堪重负。哈巴谷书中的哀叹，“律法弛缓，公理绝不行出”，与当社区被暴力淹没时，对有效保护与和平的呼求不谋而合。在这样的时刻，我们被呼召寻求雅伟的智慧和介入，以恢复公义与安全。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: Lloyds Banking Group to hire 300 tech experts to work on AI
title.zh: 劳埃德银行集团将招聘300名技术专家从事人工智能工作

summary.en: Lloyds Banking Group is recruiting 300 technology experts to focus on artificial intelligence, ahead of its chief executive's announcement of a new strategic plan. While this initiative will initially increase staff numbers, the broader implementation of AI could lead to future job reductions.
summary.zh: 劳埃德银行集团正在招聘300名技术专家，专注于人工智能领域，此前其首席执行官查理·纳恩将宣布一项新的战略计划。尽管这项举措初期会增加员工数量，但人工智能的广泛应用未来可能导致裁员。

body.en: Exclusive: While recruits will increase headcount for now, broader adoption of AI could lead to job cuts in future Lloyds Banking Group has launched an AI recruitment drive for 300 tech experts, weeks before its chief executive, Charlie Nunn, announces a strategic plan for the 261-year-old lender. The bank said it intended the recruits to work on its use and development of agentic AI by September, referring to autonomous AI models that can plan and execute tasks with minimal human oversight. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家报道：虽然目前招聘人数将增加，但人工智能的更广泛采用可能会导致未来裁员。劳埃德银行集团 (Lloyds Banking Group) 启动了一项针对 300 名技术专家的人工智能招聘活动，几周前，该银行首席执行官查理·纳恩 (Charlie Nunn) 宣布了这家拥有 261 年历史的银行的战略计划。该银行表示，希望新员工在 9 月份之前参与代理人工智能的使用和开发，指的是能够在最少的人类监督下规划和执行任务的自主人工智能模型。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI presents both opportunities and complex challenges, particularly concerning the future of human work. As leaders and organizations navigate these transformative changes, the need for profound wisdom in strategic planning becomes paramount. We are reminded to seek Yahweh's guidance, for He generously imparts wisdom to those who...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的迅速发展既带来机遇，也带来复杂的挑战，尤其是在人类工作的未来方面。当领导者和组织应对这些变革时，在战略规划中对深刻智慧的需求变得至关重要。这提醒我们寻求雅伟的指引，因为祂慷慨地将智慧赐予那些求告祂的人，帮助我们以远见和同情心管理技术进步。

verse.textEn: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.
verse.textZh: 你们中间若有缺少智慧的，应当求那厚赐与众人、也不斥责人的神，主就必赐给他。

title.en: UK taxpayers want higher levies on big tech companies, survey shows
title.zh: 调查显示，英国纳税人希望对大型科技公司征收更高税费

summary.en: A recent survey indicates that two-thirds of UK taxpayers support increasing the digital services tax on large multinational technology companies like Meta, Google, and Amazon. This reflects a public desire for these corporations to contribute more to the national economy.
summary.zh: 一项最新调查显示，三分之二的英国纳税人支持提高对Meta、谷歌和亚马逊等大型跨国科技公司的数字服务税。这反映了公众希望这些企业为国家经济做出更多贡献的愿望。

body.en: Two-thirds of respondents support increasing the 2% digital services tax for multinationals Taxpayers want the UK to increase levies on giant global technology companies such as Facebook owner Meta, Google and Amazon, a survey of Britons’ attitudes on corporate taxes suggests. The polling released on Monday by the Fair Tax Foundation – abody providing businesses with certification around responsible tax conduct – found that 67% of respondents believe that the government should charge higher digital services taxes on multinational technology groups “to increase their overall tax contribution in the UK”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 三分之二的受访者支持对跨国公司提高 2% 的数字服务税一项针对英国人对企业税态度的调查显示，纳税人希望英国提高对 Facebook 所有者 Meta、谷歌和亚马逊等大型全球科技公司的征税。公平税收基金会（Fair Tax Foundation）周一发布的民意调查发现，67%的受访者认为，政府应该对跨国科技集团征收更高的数字服务税，“以增加它们在英国的总体税收贡献”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The public's desire for higher taxes on large tech companies highlights a deep-seated longing for fairness and accountability in economic systems. Yahweh requires us to do justice, reminding leaders and corporations alike of their ethical responsibility to contribute equitably to the common good.
reflection.zh: 公众希望对大型科技公司征收更高税费的愿望，凸显了人们对经济体系中公平和问责制的深切渴望。雅伟要求我们行公义，提醒领导者和企业都有道德责任，为共同利益作出公平贡献。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

body.en: Leftwing opponent alleges vote count irregularities after Trump-endorsed lawyer secures narrow majority The Trump-admiring far-right millionaire lawyer and self-styled “outsider” Abelardo de la Espriella has won Colombia’s presidential runoff, defeating the leftwing senator Iván Cepeda. A further 1.6% of ballots were cast blank. Continue reading...
body.zh: 左翼对手在特朗普支持的律师获得微弱多数后指控计票违规这位钦佩特朗普的极右百万富翁律师和自封的“局外人”阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯普里埃拉赢得了哥伦比亚总统决选，击败了左翼参议员伊万·塞佩达。初步计票已计入99.65%的选票，德拉埃斯普里埃拉获得1,291万张选票，即49.65%，仅比塞佩达多出248,310张选票，后者获得1,267万张选票，即48.7%。另外 1.6% 的选票为空白。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to leadership, wisdom, and public responsibility. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with wisdom, integrity, and service, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到领导、智慧与公共责任。Proverbs 11:14提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以智慧、正直与服事来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Europe prepares for extreme heat as France issues red alerts
title.zh: 欧洲为极端高温做准备，法国发布红色警报

summary.en: European authorities are implementing restrictions and preparing for extreme heat as temperatures continue to rise across the continent.
summary.zh: 随着气温持续攀升，欧洲各国政府正在实施限制措施，并为即将到来的极端高温天气做准备。

body.en:
A punishing heatwave sweeping across Europe is prompting governments to impose restrictions, issue warnings and reshape daily life as temperatures climb towards record levels.

France is preparing for temperatures of up to 41C, with 35 of the country's 96 regions expected to move onto red heatwave alerts stretching from the southwest through Paris and into Burgundy.

After a crisis meeting, French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu announced restrictions on alcohol consumption at public events, including the annual Fête de la Musique celebrations across affected regions.

Authorities in Paris have also ordered parks to remain open around the clock to help residents escape the heat.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Elsewhere, heat alerts were issued across most of Germany as temperatures approached 38C.

Germany's national weather service warned that a combination of high temperatures and humidity could increase the risk of severe thunderstorms.

In Spain, authorities closed a World Cup fan zone in Madrid's Plaza de Colón that had been set up with giant screens for supporters to watch Spain's match against Saudi Arabia .

Parts of Spain remain under heat warnings, with some outdoor sporting and cultural activities suspended.

In Italy, authorities expanded heat warnings across several cities as temperatures pushed into the high 30s.

Across southern Europe, the heat has reportedly begun altering how residents and tourists move through cities.

In Rome, visitors queued in the sun outside the Colosseum while others sought relief in cooler underground spaces beneath the remains of the Temple of Claudius.

In Bologna, among Italy's hottest cities, people cooled off at the Fountain of Neptune and sheltered beneath shaded porticoes.

French authorities increased staffing across rail services amid concerns that extreme temperatures could affect infrastructure, including tracks and electrical systems.

Officials have also tightened monitoring around water supplies and bushfire conditions.

The government ordered hundreds of schools to close ahead of expected peak temperatures.

Scientists say climate change is making heatwaves more frequent and intense across Europe, increasing risks to public health and economic activity.

Bank of France governor Emmanuel Moulin said the short-term impact on growth was mixed, with reduced productivity offset in part by higher energy demand, but warned that prolonged periods of extreme heat weigh on economies over time.

Health authorities have also renewed warnings around heat exhaustion and heat stroke, particularly for older people and vulnerable communities.

body.en:
US President Donald Trump has threatened to strike Iran over its support for Hezbollah, casting uncertainty over the opening of high-stakes negotiations aimed at turning a fragile ceasefire into a longer-term peace agreement.

The warning came as senior American and Iranian officials gathered in Switzerland for the first round of talks aimed at building on a preliminary memorandum of understanding reached last week to end months of regional conflict.

Posting on Truth Social as negotiations got underway, Trump said Iran must "immediately stop their highly paid proxies in Lebanon from causing trouble".

"If they don’t, we’ll hit Iran very hard again, just like we did last week, only harder!!!" he wrote.

Iran responded swiftly with chief negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf warning Washington to “be careful” with its language, saying Tehran’s armed forces were prepared to respond and insisting American threats had failed to alter Iran’s position.

The heightened rhetoric briefly fuelled speculation that the negotiations could unravel before substantive discussions had begun.

Iranian state media reported Tehran’s delegation had left the venue in response to Trump’s comments, with some outlets suggesting the talks had been suspended.

But that account was later cast into doubt when a diplomat familiar with the negotiations told Agence France-Presse the Iranian delegation remained engaged and had not indicated to mediators any intention to withdraw.

The negotiations, mediated by Pakistan and Qatar at the Swiss resort of Bürgenstock, are intended to launch a 60-day process to negotiate a more permanent settlement and ease tensions across the region.

Iran said continued Israeli military activity and the implementation of commitments in Lebanon would dominate the opening round of talks.

The preliminary agreement signed last week committed both sides to ending hostilities across multiple fronts, including between Israel and Hezbollah.

Yet repeated clashes in southern Lebanon have raised doubts over whether that framework can hold.

Iran has insisted that meaningful progress towards a final agreement cannot happen while fighting continues.

The uncertainty around Lebanon was further complicated by comments from Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa, who publicly rejected suggestions his country could play a military role in the conflict.

Speaking to broadcaster Al Mashhad, Sharaa said Syria was focused on restoring economic ties and regional stability rather than intervening militarily.

title.en: Romania's Dan taps new PM, breaks democratic norms
title.zh: 罗马尼亚总统丹任命新总理，打破民主规范

summary.en: Romania's President Nicusor Dan has nominated a new prime minister without consulting the country's governing parties. Critics have accused President Dan of violating democratic rules through this action.

body.en:
President Nicusor Dan has nominated a new prime minister, without consulting Romania’s governing parties. Critics accuse Dan of breaking democratic rules.

Romanian President Nicusor Dan is a passionate chess player and, by all accounts, a rather good one, too. But now, amid Romania's ongoing political crisis, Dan has made a move that is not only risky but arguably breaks the rules of the democratic game.

Many are wondering what could have led Dan, a former civil society activist, to act this way.

Two months ago, Romania's four-party coalition collapsed , leaving the country without a government as the country finds itself amid severe financial and socioeconomic crisis.

In a surprise move on Sunday, Dan nominated Adrian Vestea of the National Liberal Party (PNL) as the new prime ministerial candidate, after the previous candidate had withdrawn.

Vestea, who currently serves as president of Brasov county council, does not however have the best track record. He graduated from a university of questionable academic standards, and later failed to have the access roads to a major Romanian NATO military base repaired, among other things.

Dan made his nomination without first consulting the parties in parliament, as required by the constitution. Not only that. The president nominated Vestea without the leadership his own PNL party knowing.

PNL Chairman Ilie Bolojan, who heads the current government as interim prime minister, called Vestea's nomination a "hostile act" and an "attempt to divide the PNL."

Some commentators have accused the president — once an outspoken champion of the rule of law — of disregarding democratic and constitutional principles.

Romania has been mired in a political crisis for years, with frequent changes of government. For some time now, it has had one of the highest budget deficits in the EU, in 2024 even exceeding its GDP by 9%.

Romania is under pressure to implement fundamental administrative and tax reforms, and overhaul its judicial system, which is regarded as corrupt. Without these measures, Romania faces the threat of a severe financial crisis and of losing out on many billions of euros in EU funding. Romania's political elite, however, has been reluctant to make changes.

Romania's Social Democrats (PSD), which was initially composed of former communist officials from the Ceausescu dictatorship, today predominantly champions right-wing nationalist positions. Pro-Russian far-right parties have also gained traction in recent years against the backdrop of Romania's gridlocked reforms and the growing disillusionment with its corrupt political establishment. summary.en: Five people were injured in the attacks on Friday that were described by Prime Minister Keir Starmer as being motivated by "anti-Muslim hatred."
summary.zh: 周五发生的袭击事件造成五人受伤，首相基尔·斯塔默称这些袭击是出于“反穆斯林仇恨”。

body.en:
Five people were injured in the attacks on Friday that were described by Prime Minister Keir Starmer as being motivated by "anti-Muslim hatred."

Scottish  police on Sunday said they had charged a 36-year-old man in connection with a series of attacks in Edinburgh on Friday .

"A 36-year-old man has been charged in connection with a number of incidents which took place in Edinburgh on Friday, 19 June, 2026," the Scottish police statement read.

"A report has been submitted to the procurator fiscal, and the individual will appear at court in due course.”

On Saturday, British Prime Minister Keir Starmer said that the attacks appeared to be motivated by " anti-Muslim hatred ."

"Absolutely appalling. No one should face violence on our streets," Starmer said in a post on X.

 "The suspect appears to be motivated by anti-Muslim hatred. I will not tolerate this – he will face the full force of the law."

 "There is no place for violence, racism or intolerance in our country. I met community groups last week to assure them of the strong support of the Government.”

On Friday, police said that they had responded to reports of "violent attacks including threats, robbery and vandalism" across the city and that counterterrorism police had launched a probe into the incidents

Police closed off the major Leith Walk road that connects the city center to the Leith coastal suburb.

British media reported the attacks appeared to have begun near a mosque in western Edinburgh and continued through other parts of the city.

Footage on social media appeared to show a shirtless man walking along the street carrying a weapon, and with another video showing him being restrained by police and shouting about "protecting the country."

Some five people were injured in the attacks, including three that required hospital treatment.

The incidents come amid a wave of anti-Muslim and anti- migrant sentiment in Britain, including riots in the Northern Irish capital of Belfast and in other cities.

body.zh: 周五的袭击造成五人受伤，总理基尔·斯塔默称袭击是出于“反穆斯林仇恨”。 苏格兰警方周日表示，他们已对一名 36 岁男子提出指控，该男子与周五在爱丁堡发生的一系列袭击事件有关。 苏格兰警方声明称：“一名 36 岁男子因与 2026 年 6 月 19 日星期五在爱丁堡发生的多起事件有关而受到指控。” “报告已提交给财政检察官，此人将在适当的时候出庭。” 周六，英国首相凯尔·斯塔默表示，袭击似乎是出于“反穆斯林仇恨”。 “绝对令人震惊。任何人都不应该在我们的街道上面临暴力，”斯塔默在 X 上的一篇帖子中说道。 “嫌疑人的动机似乎是反穆斯林仇恨。我不会容忍这种行为——他将面临法律的全部制裁。” “我们的国家没有暴力、种族主义或不容忍现象。上周我会见了社区团体，向他们保证政府的大力支持。” 周五，警方表示，他们已对全市“包括威胁、抢劫和破坏等暴力袭击”的报告做出回应，反恐警察已对这些事件展开调查 警方封锁了连接市中心和利斯沿海郊区的主要利斯步行道路。 英国媒体报道称，袭击似乎是从爱丁堡西部的一座清真寺附近开始，并继续蔓延到该市的其他地区。 社交媒体上的视频似乎显示一名赤裸上身的男子携带武器在街上行走，另一段视频显示他被警察制服，并高喊“保护国家”。 袭击中约有五人受伤，其中三人需要住院治疗。 这些事件发生之际，英国正掀起反穆斯林和反移民情绪，其中包括北爱尔兰首府贝尔法斯特和其他城市的骚乱。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The news of attacks motivated by anti-Muslim hatred reminds us of the ancient call to treat all people with dignity and love. Yahweh's command to love the foreigner as ourselves challenges us to overcome prejudice and embrace our shared humanity, especially in times of division.
reflection.zh: 反穆斯林仇恨引发的袭击事件提醒我们，要以尊严和爱对待所有人。雅伟吩咐我们要爱寄居的如同爱自己，这挑战我们在分裂的时代克服偏见，拥抱我们共同的人性。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Half of France under red heat alert as alcohol banned at street music festival
title.zh: 法国一半地区处于高温红色警报，街头音乐节禁止饮酒

summary.en: France is experiencing a severe heatwave, with half the country under a red alert. Authorities have warned that temperatures could reach historic highs, leading to measures like banning alcohol at a street music festival to ensure public safety.
summary.zh: 法国一半地区处于高温红色警报之下，当局警告气温可能达到历史最高水平，并已在街头音乐节禁止饮酒以确保公众安全。

body.en:
France has issued red heatwave alerts for around half the country including Paris for Monday as a heatwave pushes temperatures towards record levels.

Earlier, French authorities banned alcohol consumption in public places during the annual Fête de la Musique, a national music festival that draws millions to the streets across the country.

"For all events organised by the state and its agencies, instructions have been given not to offer alcohol," the office of Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said.

The limits on alcohol consumption aim "to preserve emergency and healthcare services and allow medical staff to focus on caring for the most vulnerable", the government said.

Temperatures have been forecast to peak on Monday, and authorities have warned they could match historic highs. The red alert covers much of western and central France, while many other regions are under an orange alert.

Nearly 850 schools are due to stay closed on Monday, while 1,500 more will let pupils leave early.

The rising temperatures are being driven by hot air moving north from the Sahara desert, which is in turn trapping hot air over western and central Europe.

Italian authorities have issued red alerts for eight cities for Sunday, including Bologna, Florence, Milan, and Turin, while Spain's weather agency has also issued red and orange alerts in several regions and warned of temperatures hitting 40 degrees across large parts of the country.

The heatwave has been building for days and has disrupted some government services in France, forcing the cancellation of dozens of trains.

France's weather service Météo-France said it was "uncertain" how long the heatwave, which has been estimated to affect about three quarters of the population, would last.

To help Parisians and tourists cope with the heat, authorities are keeping parks and gardens in the French capital open through the night.

Fête de la Musique has been going for more than 40 years, and is always held on the summer solstice.
body.zh: 法国周一向包括巴黎在内的一半国家发布红色热浪警报，热浪将气温推向创纪录水平。 早些时候，法国当局在一年一度的音乐节期间禁止在公共场所饮酒，这是一个全国性的音乐节，吸引了数百万人走上街头。 总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努办公室表示：“国家及其机构组织的所有活动均已接到指示，不得提供酒精饮料。” 政府表示，限制饮酒的目的是“维持紧急和医疗服务，并让医务人员能够专注于照顾最弱势群体”。 预计气温将于周一达到峰值，当局警告称，气温可能会达到历史最高水平。红色警报覆盖了法国西部和中部的大部分地区，而其他许多地区也处于橙色警报之下。 气温上升是由撒哈拉沙漠向北移动的热空气推动的，而热空气又将热空气困在西欧和中欧上空。 意大利当局周日向博洛尼亚、佛罗伦萨、米兰和都灵等八个城市发布红色警报，而西班牙气象局也在多个地区发布红色和橙色警报，并警告该国大部分地区气温将达到40度。 热浪已经持续数天，扰乱了法国的一些政府服务，迫使数十列火车取消并停课。 法国气象局表示，目前“不确定”热浪会持续多久，据估计，热浪将影响约四分之三的人口。 为了帮助巴黎人和游客应对炎热天气，当局让法国首都的公园和花园通宵开放。 Fête de la Musique 已经举办了 40 多年，并且总是在夏至举行。

reflection.en: As France faces extreme heat, we are reminded of creation's deep interconnectedness and its vulnerability to strain. Romans 8:22 speaks of creation groaning, a poignant image for our world experiencing such intense conditions. In these moments, we are called to compassion and wise action, caring for one another amidst the challenges nature presents.
reflection.zh: 当法国面临极端高温时，我们被提醒创造物之间深刻的相互关联及其承受压力的脆弱性。罗马书8:22提到创造物一同叹息，这是对我们世界经历如此强烈状况的生动写照。在这些时刻，我们被呼召要怀着怜悯和智慧行动，在自然带来的挑战中彼此关怀。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Ethiopia PM's party wins landslide as fears grow of new conflict
title.zh: 诺贝尔和平奖得主在埃塞俄比亚大选中获胜，但对新冲突的担忧日益加剧

summary.en: Abiy Ahmed's party retains its huge majority despite unrest in several parts of Ethiopia and tensions with its neighbours.
summary.zh: 尽管埃塞俄比亚多个地区出现动荡，并与邻国关系紧张，阿比·艾哈迈德的政党仍保持了其巨大的多数席位。

body.en:
Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed is the big winner following the country's general election as his party has retained its overwhelming parliamentary majority, despite the poll being overshadowed by conflict, accusations of repression and little participation by opposition parties.

The Prosperity Party, which won 438 of the 501 contested seats, will form the new government with Abiy set to be sworn in for another term at the beginning of October. It is a boon for Abiy's supporters, who believe he will continue with the economic gains he has overseen.

But others fear the internal divisions and security challenges facing Africa's second most-populous country are only going to get worse with Abiy at the helm.

The 49-year-old first came to power amid anti-government protests in 2018, and he was at first hailed for his campaign to heal divisions - though he upset politicians from the northern region of Tigray who had dominated the government for more than two decades.

Just a year later he won the Nobel Peace Prize, mainly for his efforts in ending hostilities with Ethiopia's northern neighbour Eritrea.

But security experts fear the country could be heading back to war, while the violent and deadly insurgencies in Ethiopia's Amhara and Oromia regions show no sign of ending.

On election day, 143 polling stations failed to open in the country's two most-populous regions because of safety concerns caused by armed groups fighting the government.

The Fano militias in Amhara and the proscribed Oromo Liberation Army (OLA) in Oromia, which both want greater autonomy, rejected the election and its results.

The situation is also troubling in Tigray, which is still recovering from a two-year civil war that only ended in 2022. The region and its six million inhabitants, comprising 38 constituencies, were completely excluded from the poll amid rising fears that fighting could break out once more.

Tigray borders Eritrea and during the war, its troops were allied with Ethiopian government forces. They were accused of widespread atrocities against Tigrayan civilians, which were denied . But since the conflict ended, relations between Addis Ababa and Asmara have sharply deteriorated.

Eritrea, with its 1,350km (840-mile) coastline, accuses landlocked Ethiopia of having imperial ambitions. Over the last three years Abiy has repeatedly spoken of his country's need to regain access to a Red Sea port , which it lost when Eritrea became independent in 1993.

In a dramatic about-turn, Asmara has now allied itself with Tigray's leaders - and should any new conflict erupt, it is likely that Eritrea would side with Tigrayan forces and vice-versa.

body.zh: 埃塞俄比亚总理阿比·艾哈迈德是该国大选后的大赢家，尽管选举因冲突、镇压指控和反对党很少参与而蒙上阴影，但他的政党仍然保持了议会压倒性多数。 繁荣党在宣布的 501 个席位中拥有 438 个席位，将组建新政府，阿比将于 10 月初宣誓就职，连任。这对阿比的支持者来说是一个福音，他们相信他将继续取得他所监督的经济成果。 但其他人担心，随着阿比的掌舵，这个非洲第二人口大国面临的内部分歧和安全挑战只会变得更糟。 这位 49 岁的总统于 2018 年在反政府抗议活动中首次上台，他最初因其弥合分歧的运动而受到称赞，尽管他让来自提格雷北部地区的政客感到不满，他们在政府中占据了二十多年的统治地位。 仅仅一年后，他就获得了诺贝尔和平奖，主要是因为他为结束与埃塞俄比亚北部邻国厄立特里亚的敌对行动所做的努力。 但安全专家担心该国可能会重新陷入战争，而埃塞俄比亚阿姆哈拉和奥罗米亚地区的暴力和致命叛乱却没有结束的迹象。 选举当天，由于与政府作战的武装团体引起的安全问题，该国两个人口最多地区的 143 个投票站未能开放。 阿姆哈拉的法诺民兵和奥罗米亚被禁的奥罗莫解放军（OLA）都希望获得更大的自治权，拒绝了选举及其结果。 提格雷的情况也令人不安，该地区仍在从 2022 年才结束的两年内战中恢复过来。由于人们越来越担心战斗可能再次爆发，该地区及其 36 个选区的 600 万居民被完全排除在投票之外。 提格雷与厄立特里亚接壤，战争期间，其军队与埃塞俄比亚政府军结盟。他们被指控对提格雷平民实施广泛的暴行，但遭到否认。但自冲突结束以来，亚的斯亚贝巴和阿斯马拉之间的关系急剧恶化。 拥有 1,350 公里（840 英里）海岸线的厄立特里亚指责内陆埃塞俄比亚有帝国野心。在过去三年里，阿比多次表示，厄立特里亚需要重新获得红海港口的使用权，该国在厄立特里亚于 1993 年独立时失去了该港口。 阿斯马拉现在发生了戏剧性的转变，与提格雷领导人结盟——如果爆发任何新的冲突，厄立特里亚很可能会站在提格雷军队一边，反之亦然。 亚的斯亚贝巴还被指控卷入与埃塞俄比亚和...接壤的苏丹内战。

reflection.en: A leader's electoral success brings with it a profound responsibility to ensure peace and justice for all citizens. Even as a Nobel Peace Prize winner secures power, the rising fears of conflict highlight the ongoing call for leaders to actively prevent violence and protect the vulnerable. Yahweh's ancient mandate reminds us that true authority is...
reflection.zh: 一位领导人的选举胜利，伴随着为所有公民确保和平与正义的深远责任。即使一位诺贝尔和平奖得主巩固了权力，日益增长的冲突担忧也凸显了领导人积极防止暴力和保护弱势群体的持续呼召。雅伟古老的诫命提醒我们，真正的权威是通过维护公义和使人民脱离欺压而建立的。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: UK's Starmer mulls 'political realities' after Burnham by-election
title.zh: 英国斯塔默在伯纳姆补选后思考“政治现实”

summary.en: A member of UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer's Cabinet said it would be "delusional" to pretend there was no threat to his position. But he also said he had no information suggesting he might quit, as a newspaper reported.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.zh: 英国首相凯尔·斯塔默的内阁成员表示，假装他的职位没有受到威胁是“妄想”。但据报纸报道，他也表示，没有任何信息表明他可能会辞职。 英国商业大臣彼得·凯尔周日表示，在首相职位的潜在竞争对手安迪·伯纳姆周四赢得补选并赢得下议院席位后，基尔·斯塔默正在反思“政治现实”。 理论上来说，进入议会将使伯纳姆成为首相，或者引发对工党领导权的敌对竞争，进而获得英国最高政治职位。 自 2024 年大选获胜以来，斯塔默和工党的支持率不断下降，特别是工党上个月在地方和地区选举中表现不佳，斯塔默面临着越来越大的压力。 凯尔周日在分别接受天空电视台和英国广播公司采访时表示，他没有理由相信斯塔默计划在周一宣布辞职——正如左倾周刊《观察家报》报道的那样。 “今天，就像我认识凯尔的其他日子一样，他在外面努力工作，”凯尔告诉天空新闻。 “与此同时，他还试图创造一个空间，让他能够思考和反思我们面前的政治现实和挑战以及机遇。” 他没有重复唐宁街上周晚些时候发出的言论，即如果出现任何领导层挑战，斯塔默将参与竞争。 在后来的英国广播公司采访中，这位部长承认，他的党内至少有一些势力正在对斯塔默采取行动。 他说：“我不想来到这里，妄想没有任何程序，没有任何力量在挑战总理的领导地位。情况显然就是这样。” 工党的安迪·伯纳姆(Andy Burnham)以相当大的优势赢得了周四的梅克菲尔德补选，并为该党带来了近几个月来罕见的好消息，这让特雷莎·梅在苏格兰、威尔士和英国地方议会选举失败后立即引发的猜测再次升温。 凯尔周日在电视上面临尖锐的质疑，因为左倾的《观察家报》周六晚间发表的一篇报道称，总理正在考虑他的未来，最快可能在周一宣布这一消息。 该报报道称，斯塔默在周末在切克斯乡村官邸与妻子讨论了自己的未来，然后做出了决定，但没有透露工党高级官员的消息来源。 伯勒姆并不是斯塔默唯一的潜在挑战者，但许多人都认为这位 56 岁的前曼彻斯特市长......

reflection.en: This story draws attention to leadership, wisdom, and public responsibility. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with wisdom, integrity, and service, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到领导、智慧与公共责任。Proverbs 11:14提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以智慧、正直与服事来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Low-key funeral held for giant of the art world David Hockney
title.zh: 艺术界巨人大卫·霍克尼低调葬礼

summary.en: The artist, who passed away at his home in London earlier this month, requested just his partner and great-nephew attend.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The funeral of David Hockney, widely regarded as Britain's best-known artist, has already taken place, his publicist has confirmed.

The 88-year-old died at his home in London earlier this month, prompting tributes from his contemporaries in the art world, the prime minister and senior members of the Royal Family.

As per his wishes, his partner Jean-Pierre Goncalves de Lima and his great-nephew Richard Hockney were the only two mourners to attend his funeral, Hockney's publicist Erica Bolton said.

A series of memorial services for the painter are set to take place next year, with the first being held in London in the spring, she added.

This will be followed by further memorials in Los Angeles and Paris, both cities David Hockney called home at different times in his life, and Yorkshire - where he was born.

It has also been confirmed that most of Hockney's works will now be given to foundations and public institutions around the world to preserve his legacy.

Over his seven-decade career, Hockney was famous for his vibrant and innovative artworks, including landscapes of his native Yorkshire, sun-drenched paintings of Los Angeles swimming pools, and iPad portraits of friends and family.

A defining figure of the pop art movement in the 1960s, he maintained huge popularity throughout his life. In 2018, one of his swimming pool paintings sold for nearly £70m at auction - a record for a living artist.

Some of his best-known works included The Splash, A Bigger Splash and Portrait Of An Artist (Pool With Two Figures).

Following Hockney's death, King Charles said he and Queen Camilla had been "greatly saddened" to learn of the death of "a giant of the world of art and painting, a Yorkshireman through and through, and a dear friend and inspiration to so many".

Artist Dame Tracey Emin said she felt privileged to have known Hockney, describing him as "a great artist and a wonderful man, who with the power of art changed the perception of Britishness. A proud chain-smoking homosexual, who flew the flag higher than any other British artist."

Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer said he was saddened to hear of the death of "one of Britain's most celebrated artists".

An exhibition of Hockney's work is currently taking place until August at Serpentine Galleries in London's Kensington Gardens.

Two exhibitions are due to be held next year to mark what would have been David Hockney's 90th birthday. Tate Modern will stage a multimedia installation, while Tate Britain will host a exhibition spanning his career.

Bolton said the upcoming memorials were "in accordance with David's wishes", and that the details of his funeral had not been publicly disclosed in the interest of his loved ones' privacy.
body.zh: 大卫·霍克尼被广泛认为是英国最著名的艺术家，他的公关人员证实，他的葬礼已经举行。 这位 88 岁的老人本月早些时候在伦敦的家中去世，引起了艺术界同代人、首相和王室高级成员的悼念。 霍克尼的公关埃里卡·博尔顿说，按照他的意愿，他的伴侣让-皮埃尔·贡萨尔维斯·德利马和他的侄孙理查德·霍克尼是仅有的两名参加他葬礼的哀悼者。 她补充说，这位画家的一系列纪念活动将于明年举行，第一次活动将于春季在伦敦举行。 随后，大卫·霍克尼在洛杉矶和巴黎这两个城市以及他的出生地约克郡将举行进一步的纪念活动，这两座城市是大卫·霍克尼在其一生中不同时期的家乡。 据证实，霍克尼的大部分作品现在将捐赠给世界各地的基金会和公共机构，以保存他的遗产。 在他七十年的职业生涯中，霍​​克尼以其充满活力和创新的艺术作品而闻名，包括他的家乡约克郡的风景画、阳光普照的洛杉矶游泳池的画作以及朋友和家人的 iPad 肖像。 作为 20 世纪 60 年代波普艺术运动的决定性人物，他一生都保持着巨大的人气。 2018 年，他的一幅泳池画在拍卖会上以近 7000 万英镑的价格售出，创下了在世艺术家的拍卖纪录。 他最著名的作品包括《水花》、《更大的水花》和《艺术家肖像》（有两个人物的泳池）。 霍克尼去世后，查尔斯国王表示，他和卡米拉王后得知“一位艺术和绘画界的巨人、一位彻头彻尾的约克郡人、一位亲爱的朋友和许多人的灵感来源”的去世感到“非常悲伤”。 艺术家特雷西·艾敏爵士 (Dame Tracey Emin) 表示，她很荣幸能够认识霍克尼，并形容他是“一位伟大的艺术家和一位出色的人，他用艺术的力量改变了人们对英国人的看法。一位自豪的连续吸烟的同性恋者，他的旗帜比任何其他英国艺术家都高高飘扬。” 英国首相凯尔·斯塔默爵士表示，他对“英国最著名的艺术家之一”去世的消息感到悲痛。 霍克尼的作品展览目前正在伦敦肯辛顿花园的蛇形画廊举办，直至八月。 明年将举办两场展览来纪念大卫·霍克尼的 90 岁生日。泰特现代美术馆将举办多媒体装置展，而泰特英国美术馆将举办一场跨越他职业生涯的展览。 博尔顿表示，即将举行的纪念活动“符合大卫的意愿”，并且为了保护他亲人的隐私，他的葬礼细节并未公开披露。

title.en: UN warns of 'imminent risk of mass atrocities' in Sudan
title.zh: 联合国警告苏丹存在“大规模暴行迫在眉睫的风险”

summary.en: The UN Security Council has issued a warning about the "imminent risk of mass atrocities" in Sudan, stating that aid organizations are preparing for the displacement of a large number of people from a southern region of the country.
summary.zh: 联合国安理会警告苏丹存在“大规模暴行迫在眉睫的风险”，并表示援助机构正在为该国南部地区大量民众的迁徙做准备。

body.en:
The United Nations Security Council said Saturday it is concerned over the "imminent risk of mass atrocities" in Sudan as it called on paramilitary forces encircling El-Obeid to back down.

The majority-Muslim southern city, in the Kordofan region, has been under siege for several months by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), which has been at war with the regular army since April 2023.

"The members of the Security Council expressed concern at the imminent risk of mass atrocities and demanded the RSF immediately halt its assault on El-Obeid," the Security Council said in a statement.

"Council members called on the parties to the conflict to immediately halt the fighting."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The UN has voiced fears that there could be a repeat of the atrocities committed during the October 2025 assault on the city of El-Fasher, which it said bore "hallmarks of genocide."

The UN said Friday that Pekka Haavisto, the secretary-general's special envoy for Sudan, had called rebel paramilitary forces chief Mohamed Hamdan Daglo to urge him not to attack El-Obeid.

Haavisto "underscored the need to urgently de-escalate the situation in El-Obeid and avoid any actions that may further worsen the already dire humanitarian situation and put civilian lives further at risk," said Stephane Dujarric, spokesman for UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres.

The official said aid workers were "preparing for the potential movements of large numbers of people" fleeing the city, and that "our humanitarian colleagues are doing the responsible thing, which is getting ready for the worst while hoping for the best."

Dujarric said Haavisto was also talking to countries with influence over the warring parties to encourage dialogue and prevent the assault.

The conflict in Sudan has killed tens of thousands of people and forced more than 11 million from their homes, creating what the UN describes as the world's largest displacement and hunger crises.

Yahweh calls us to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, especially the destitute whose rights are at risk. title.en: 'History not positive': Albanese warns of leaders spill amid Keir Starmer resignation reports
title.zh: “历史并不乐观”：阿尔巴尼斯就基尔·斯塔默辞职传闻警告领导人更迭

summary.en: Albanese says he will deal with whoever is in power as pressure mounts on Keir Starmer's leadership.

body.en:
Australia's Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has warned against a leadership change in the United Kingdom amid reports his British Labour counterpart Keir Starmer could be about to resign.

Britain's Observer newspaper is reporting Starmer is expected to resign on Monday and set out a timetable for his departure.

The Observer report, which did not name its sources, said Starmer had reached the conclusion that his position was no longer tenable after speaking to cabinet ministers, advisers, donors and trade union leaders.

However, a government source said Starmer remained focused on getting on with the job of governing.

Asked about the potential change by Sky News on Sunday morning, Albanese said he will "deal with whoever is elected".

"But I must say that the history of just changing leaders is not a positive one," he said. "I've dealt with already four British prime ministers since I've been elected as prime minister."

Speculation of Starmer's retirement has been building for months and has accelerated since Friday, when his rival Andy Burnham won more than 50 per cent of the vote in the Makerfield byelection, officially allowing him to now launch a formal leadership challenge.

Burnham, the 56-year-old mayor of Greater Manchester, is widely seen as Starmer's most likely successor, whether through a negotiated transfer of power or a formal leadership contest.

He used his victory speech to promise a new path for the United Kingdom, rather than launching an immediate formal challenge.

Starmer said on Friday he would fight any challenge to his leadership and urged Labour not to tear itself apart with infighting.

Starmer led the centre-left Labour party to a landslide election win in 2024, but became deeply unpopular after a series of scandals, policy U-turns and local election defeats.

More than 100 elected lawmakers in Starmer's party - roughly a quarter of all Labour representatives in the House of Commons - have publicly said they want him to quit or set out a timetable for his exit, according to a Reuters tally.

If he were to quit or be ousted, it would be the United Kingdom's seventh prime minister in just over a decade — the highest turnover in nearly two centuries.

Albanese has previously backed Starmer's leadership, in May saying: "He is a friend of mine, and I hope that Keir Starmer continues to serve as prime minister of the United Kingdom", and warning that the, "revolving door of leaders does not lead to stability".

title.en: Terror police probe suspected anti-Muslim attacks in Edinburgh
title.zh: 恐怖警察调查爱丁堡疑似反穆斯林袭击事件

summary.en: Counterterrorism police are investigating a series of violent attacks in Edinburgh, Scotland, which resulted in five men being injured.
summary.zh: 苏格兰首都爱丁堡发生一系列暴力袭击事件，导致五名男子受伤，反恐警察已接手调查。

body.en:
Counterterrorism police have taken charge after a series of violent attacks in the Scottish capital that left five men injured.

Counterterrorism police have taken over an investigation into suspected anti-Muslim violence in Edinburgh, Scotland , that left five men injured, authorities said Saturday.

The unrest comes as the United Kingdom  is seeing a wave of anti-migrant and anti-Muslim sentiment, including recent riots in Northern Ireland and England .

Emergency services responded late Friday to reports of "violent attacks including threats, robbery and vandalism" across the city, according to a police statement.

Local media reported the attacks began near a mosque before spreading to other areas of the city.

Footage posted to social media appeared to show a shirtless man walking along a street carrying a long weapon.

Another video seemed to show the same man being held on the ground by a police officer and shouting about "protecting the country" from Muslims.

Police said five people — two aged 22 and three others aged 24, 27, and 39 — sustained injuries.

Three of the victims required hospital treatment, but none of the injuries were life-threatening, police said.

A 36-year-old Scottish man was arrested, and authorities said there was no further threat to the public.

"Counter Terrorism Policing Scotland is investigating, supported by other specialist colleagues and local policing officers," the statement said.

The anti-Islamophobia non-profit MEND said several of the victims were Muslims and urged police to "treat this as what the evidence indicates: Islamophobic, far-right terror."

Scotland's First Minister John Swinney said he was "deeply concerned" by the incidents.

Assistant Chief Constable Catriona Paton called for calm, saying "there is no place for racism or faith-based hate in Scotland." The incident follows a broader pattern of unrest across the UK, where tensions over immigration and multiculturalism remain elevated. Critics say far-right groups have been stoking anti-migrant and anti-Muslim sentiment in recent months.

Last week, Belfast saw two nights of serious disorder after a brutal knife attack on a local man.

Video of the incident, allegedly carried out by a Sudanese asylum seeker, spread rapidly online and triggered protests that escalated into violence, with homes and vehicles set on fire.

The week before, protesters clashed with police in Southampton, southern England, over the handling of the murder of 18-year-old student Henry Nowak, who was fatally stabbed by a British Sikh man.

The unrest comes as Reform UK, the anti-immigration populist party led by Nigel Farage, has taken a clear lead in opinion polls.

strap.zh: 聚焦中国内部政策走向、社会变化与国家动态。

title.en: ‘A hunting ground for foreign regimes’: why violent attacks on dissidents are on the rise in Britain
title.zh: “外国政权的猎场”：为何针对异议人士的暴力袭击在英国日益增多

summary.en: Reports indicate a rise in violent attacks on dissidents living in the UK, with Iran and China accused of targeting critics. An arson attack on Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s properties has also been linked to Russia.
summary.zh: 报道指出，居住在英国的异议人士遭受的暴力袭击有所增加，伊朗和中国被指控针对批评者。针对首相基尔·斯塔默房产的纵火袭击也被认为与俄罗斯有关。

body.en: Iran and China among those accused of targeting critics living in the UK, as arson attack on prime minister Keir Starmer’s properties linked to Russia As Pouria Zeraati was crossing the street between his Wimbledon home and his car in south London in March 2024, he was confronted by two men. One held him firmly as the other stabbed him three times in the leg before they both fled. It was later said to be a targeted attack on behalf of the Iranian regime in Tehran. A punishment for Zeraati’s work as a journalist covering Iran . He survived, but the ambush is one of dozens of violent incidents in recent years linked to foreign states. Russia, China, India, Saudi Arabia and Iran have all been blamed for targeting critics and dissidents living in the UK in the past decade, and linked to incidents involving physical assaults, attempted kidnap, stabbings and an acid attack. Continue reading...
body.zh: 伊朗和中国被指控针对居住在英国的批评者，对首相基尔·斯塔默与俄罗斯有关的财产进行纵火袭击。 2024 年 3 月，当普里亚·泽拉蒂 (Pouria Zeraati) 在伦敦南部温布尔登的家和他的汽车之间过马路时，遇到了两名男子。一个人牢牢地抓住了他，另一个人则在他的腿上刺了三刀，然后他们就逃跑了。后来据称这是针对德黑兰伊朗政权的一次有针对性的袭击。对泽拉蒂作为报道伊朗的记者的惩罚。他幸存下来，但这次伏击是近年来与外国有关的数十起暴力事件之一。俄罗斯、中国、印度、沙特阿拉伯和伊朗都被指责在过去十年中针对居住在英国的批评者和持不同政见者，并与涉及人身攻击、企图绑架、刺伤和硫酸袭击的事件有关。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report highlights the chilling reality of oppressive regimes extending their reach to silence critics abroad. Proverbs 28:15 reminds us that a wicked ruler can be like a dangerous predator to a helpless people, illustrating the vulnerability of those who speak truth to power. In such times, we pray for the safety of dissidents and for justice to...
reflection.zh: 这篇报道揭示了压迫性政权将魔爪伸向海外，以压制批评者的严峻现实。箴言28:15提醒我们，邪恶的统治者对无助的人民来说，如同咆哮的狮子或冲锋的熊，这形象地描绘了那些向权力说真话的人所面临的脆弱处境。在这样的时刻，我们为异议人士的安全祷告，并祈求公义战胜那些试图压制自由的势力。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Petrol prices in Australia are now lower than before the Iran war began. Is the oil crisis over and what happens next?
title.zh: 澳大利亚汽油价格已低于伊朗战争爆发前水平。石油危机结束了吗？接下来会发生什么？

summary.en: Australian petrol prices have fallen below pre-Middle East conflict levels, surprising analysts who had warned of shortages and record high prices. This unexpected flexibility from non-Middle Eastern fuel suppliers, including China, has led to a significant drop in costs.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的汽油价格已降至中东冲突爆发前的水平，这出乎分析师的意料，他们此前曾警告可能出现燃料短缺和价格飙升。中东以外的燃料供应商，包括中国，展现出超出预期的灵活性，导致油价显著下降。

body.en: Fuel suppliers outside the Middle East have proved to be much more flexible than analysts expected – and China surprised everyone Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australians were warned soon after the Middle East conflict started that the country could run short on fuel, with prices rising to record levels owing to disrupted oil supplies. Now, amid an uneasy peace deal and continued supply disruptions, petrol prices are lower than they were before the conflict began and official warnings over fuel usage have largely disappeared. Continue reading...
body.zh: 事实证明，中东以外的燃料供应商比分析师预期的灵活得多，而中国令所有人感到惊讶。中东冲突爆发后不久，澳大利亚人就收到警告称，该国可能出现燃料短缺，由于石油供应中断，价格上涨至创纪录水平。现在，由于和平协议不稳定，供应持续中断，汽油价格低于冲突开始前，官方对燃料使用的警告也基本消失。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The unexpected drop in petrol prices, after initial warnings of scarcity and record highs, reminds us that periods of anxiety can give way to relief. Just as weeping may endure for a night, joy can indeed come in the morning, often through unforeseen circumstances. This turn of events offers a hopeful perspective on how challenges can resolve in ways we...
reflection.zh: 汽油价格在最初警告可能出现短缺和创纪录高位后，意外下降，这提醒我们，焦虑时期可能会迎来缓解。正如哭泣可能持续一夜，喜乐确实会在早晨到来，而且常常是通过意想不到的情况。这一转变提供了一个充满希望的视角，说明挑战可能以我们未曾预料的方式得到解决。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: Charging ahead: EVs outpace growth predictions
title.zh: 电动汽车：超越增长预期，加速前进

summary.en: Electric vehicles are becoming more affordable, efficient, and capable of longer distances, exceeding initial growth forecasts. China is leading this transition, with Europe and other nations rapidly advancing as well.
summary.zh: 电动汽车正变得更便宜、更高效，续航里程也比以往任何时候都长，其增长速度超出了预期。中国正在推动这一转型，而欧洲和其他国家也正在迅速追赶。

body.zh: 电动汽车变得越来越便宜、越来越高效，而且行驶距离比以往任何时候都更远。中国正在推动这一转型，但欧洲和其他国家正在快速追赶。 全球电动汽车 (EV) 市场的增长速度远远快于预期。短短六年内，销量增长了十倍，到 2025 年，全球电动汽车销量将达到约 2100 万辆。 中国和欧洲处于领先地位，但世界其他地区的市场也在快速增长。 中国长期以来一直在投资太阳能和风能以及电池技术——电动汽车最关键的组成部分。 得益于先进的研究和大规模生产，电动汽车电池成本大幅下降。如今，它们的成本仅为 10 年前的四分之一，而且价格还在继续下降。 中国是世界上最大的汽车市场，消费者正在从政府的产业战略中获益。自 2024 年以来，电动汽车的成本低于内燃机汽车，国家多年来一直在迅速扩大充电基础设施，而且中国的电力非常实惠。 2015年，电动汽车仅占中国新车销量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，这一比例已攀升至 61%。 电动汽车依靠电力运行并通过电缆充电。在全球范围内，三分之二的电动汽车是所谓的电池电动汽车 (BEV)，仅由电力驱动。剩下的三分之一还配备了燃气发动机，用于长途旅行时的备用——这些被称为增程电动汽车 (EREV) 或插电式混合动力电动汽车 (PHEV)。 相比之下，所谓的混合动力电动汽车 (HEV) 始终需要汽油或柴油来为其内燃机提供动力。电动机提供一些帮助，仅通过再生制动产生电力。这项技术在一定程度上降低了城市驾驶的燃油消耗，但混合动力汽车在国际统计中并未被算作电动汽车。 2018年，电动汽车仅占欧盟新车注册量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，售出的新车中近三分之一是电动汽车。 北欧处于领先地位。在挪威，现在销售的几乎所有新车都是电动汽车（99%），其次是丹麦（82%）和瑞典（65%）。该地区各国政府支持气候友好型出行，并正在扩大充电基础设施。 在英国，2026 年 4 月注册的新车中有 39% 是电动汽车，其次是德国（37%）和法国（32%）。在这三个国家，电动汽车销量与去年同月相比都翻了一番。 近年来，美国市场陷入停滞。 2023 年至 2025 年间，电动汽车占...

reflection.en: The rapid advancements in electric vehicle technology, making them cheaper and more efficient, reflect a remarkable acceleration of human knowledge and innovation. This progress reminds us of the human capacity to explore and develop new solutions, continually expanding our understanding and capabilities.
reflection.zh: 电动汽车技术日新月异，变得更便宜、更高效，这反映了人类知识和创新的显著加速。这种进步提醒我们，人类有能力探索和开发新的解决方案，不断拓展我们的理解和能力。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: For women in China frustrated by sexism, female comics are offering a release
title.zh: 在中国，女性喜剧演员为厌倦性别歧视的女性提供宣泄出口

summary.en: Standup comedy in China is providing a platform for women to discuss sensitive topics, including sexism, offering a sense of release and shared experience. Performers, however, remain cautious of censorship limits as they navigate this space in venues like a small performing arts theatre in east Beijing.
summary.zh: 中国的脱口秀喜剧为女性提供了一个平台，让她们可以讨论包括性别歧视在内的敏感话题，从而获得宣泄和共同的体验。然而，表演者们在北京东部一家小型表演艺术剧院等场所进行表演时，仍对审查限制保持警惕。

body.en: Standup comedy gives women a space to talk about certain topics that have become more sensitive, while performers remain wary of censorship limits Packed into the upstairs theatre of a small performing arts space in east Beijing, more than 100 people, mostly women, are giddy with anticipation. “Who did you come to see?” asks the MC, fashionably dressed in a faded denim two-piece suit. The answer is bellowed in unison back to him: “Fang Zhuren!” Fang Shaoli, AKA Director Fang ( Fang Zhuren ), has built a cult following in China in the past two years. Decidedly less fashionable than the evening’s host, Fang is dressed in a yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans. Her everywoman attire is part of the appeal. With a stout frame and short, sensible haircut, Fang, who was born in 1975, hails from rural part of east China’s Shandong province. Before discovering the art of standup comedy she worked in factories and on construction sites, but mainly lived as a housewife to a difficult husband. Her jokes riff on the deep sexism that permeates Chinese culture, particularly away from the big urban centres like Beijing and Shanghai. Continue reading...
body.zh: 单口喜剧为女性提供了谈论某些变得更加敏感的话题的空间，而表演者们仍然对审查制度的限制保持警惕北京东部一个小型表演艺术空间的楼上剧场里，有 100 多人（其中大部分是女性）满怀期待。 “你是来看谁的？”身穿褪色牛仔两件套西装的主持人问道。对方齐声喊道：“方主任！”方绍立，又名方主任（方主任），过去两年在中国建立了一批狂热的追随者。方穿着黄色连帽衫和深蓝色牛仔裤，明显不如当晚主持人时尚。她的普通女性着装是其吸引力的一部分。方出生于1975年，来自中国东部山东省的农村地区，身材魁梧，留着一头漂亮的短发。在发现单口喜剧艺术之前，她曾在工厂和建筑工地工作过，但主要是作为一位难相处的丈夫的家庭主妇生活。她的笑话反复提及了渗透在中国文化中的根深蒂固的性别歧视，尤其是在远离北京和上海等大城市中心的地方。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story highlights the human need to express frustrations and experiences, especially when facing societal pressures like sexism. Proverbs 31:8-9 reminds us of the importance of speaking up for those whose voices are often unheard, advocating for justice and dignity. Even in challenging environments, creative expression can offer a vital space for shared...
reflection.zh: 这个故事突显了人类表达挫折和经历的需求，尤其是在面对性别歧视等社会压力时。箴言31:8-9提醒我们，为那些常常被忽视的声音发声，倡导公义和尊严是何等重要。即使在充满挑战的环境中，创造性的表达也能为共同的理解和释放提供一个重要的空间，这反映了雅伟对边缘群体的关怀。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Border Force officer and Hong Kong trade official jailed for spying for China
title.zh: 英国边境部队官员和香港贸易官员因替中国从事间谍活动被判入狱

summary.en: A UK Border Force officer and a Hong Kong trade official have been sentenced to 10 and eight years in prison, respectively, after being convicted of spying for China. These are the first convictions under the UK's National Security Act.
summary.zh: 一名英国边境部队官员和一名香港贸易官员因替中国从事间谍活动而被判入狱，刑期分别为10年和8年。这是英国根据《国家安全法》首次定罪的案件。

body.en: Peter Wai and Bill Yuen sentenced to 10 and eight years at Old Bailey in first convictions under National Security Act A UK Border Force officer and a Hong Kong trade official based in London have been jailed for spying for China in the first such conviction in British criminal history. Peter Wai, who conducted “shadow policing” operations on Chinese dissidents in the UK, was sentenced to 10 years, while his handler, Bill Yuen, received an eight-year term. Continue reading...
body.zh: Peter Wai和Bill Yuen根据《国家安全法》首次在老贝利被判刑10年和8年。一名英国边防部队官员和一名驻伦敦的香港贸易官员因为中国从事间谍活动而被判入狱，这是英国犯罪史上的首次此类定罪。在英国对中国持不同政见者进行“影子警察”行动的韦彼得被判处10年徒刑，而他的经纪人袁比尔则被判处8年徒刑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights the profound breach of trust when public officials betray their duties. Yahweh's word reminds us that faithfulness in small responsibilities reflects our character in larger ones. May we all strive for integrity in every role we are given, understanding that honesty builds trust and strengthens the fabric of society.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了公职人员背叛职责时对信任的严重破坏。雅伟的话语提醒我们，在小事上忠心的人，在大事上也忠心。愿我们都在所担任的每一个角色中追求正直，明白诚实能建立信任并巩固社会结构。

verse.textEn: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
verse.textZh: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。

title.en: Inspired by Ukraine, and worried by China: Taiwan teaches its citizens how to fly drones
title.zh: 受乌克兰启发，担忧中国大陆：台湾教导市民如何驾驶无人机

summary.en: Ordinary citizens in Taiwan are enrolling in drone piloting courses, inspired by events in Ukraine and concerned about a potential military threat from China. These courses teach participants, young and old, how to operate drones for various purposes.
summary.zh: 受乌克兰局势的启发并担忧中国大陆的军事威胁，台湾普通民众（包括年轻人和老年人）正在参加无人机驾驶课程。这些课程旨在教授学员如何操作无人机以应对潜在情况。

body.en: Ordinary Taiwanese, young and old, are joining courses to learn how to fly drones amid looming China military threat In a small, crowded room in Taipei, Pan Chien-chin is trying to keep a drone hovering steadily. Imagining himself flying a plane, he gently nudges controller joysticks to guide the insect-like device as it hums through the air. Cheers break out as Pan, who has never flown a drone before, steers it around a rectangular course marked by traffic cones without crashing. Around him are about two dozen fellow trainees, all signed up for the same course: Taiwan’s first civil defence drone training programme. Continue reading...
body.zh: 台湾普通民众，无论老少，都在参加课程，学习如何在迫在眉睫的中国军事威胁下驾驶无人机。在台北一间拥挤的小房间里，潘建钦正努力让无人机保持稳定盘旋。他想象自己驾驶一架飞机，轻轻推动控制器操纵杆，引导昆虫般的设备在空中嗡嗡作响。当潘以前从未驾驶过无人机时，他驾驶无人机绕着一个由交通锥标标记的矩形航线飞行，没有坠毁，引发了欢呼声。他周围大约有两打学员，他们都报名参加同一门课程：台湾首个民防无人机训练计划。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The story highlights a community's proactive response to perceived threats, reflecting a natural human inclination to prepare for potential dangers. Proverbs reminds us of the wisdom in foreseeing trouble and taking steps to protect ourselves and our communities. Such foresight, when coupled with a reliance on Yahweh, can guide us in uncertain times.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻讲述了一个社区如何积极应对潜在威胁，反映了人类为可能出现的危险做准备的自然倾向。箴言提醒我们，预见祸患并采取措施保护自己和社区是智慧之举。这种远见，若能与对雅伟的信靠结合，便能在不确定的时期指引我们。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Lululemon apologises after Japanese drum row at Great Wall yoga event
title.zh: Lululemon因长城瑜伽活动中的日本太鼓风波致歉

summary.en: The activewear brand Lululemon issued an apology after an online uproar in China. The controversy stemmed from a promotional yoga event held on the Great Wall of China, where a Japanese taiko drum was mistakenly featured instead of a Chinese drum, despite the event being intended to celebrate Chinese culture.
summary.zh: 运动服饰品牌Lululemon因在中国长城举办的瑜伽推广活动中误用日本太鼓而引发网络争议后，发表了道歉声明。尽管该活动旨在庆祝中国文化，但这一失误在中国引发了线上轩然大波。

body.en: Online uproar follows Canadian brand’s use of taiko drum at sponsored festival held to celebrate Chinese culture The activewear brand Lululemon has apologised after a promotional event held on the Great Wall of China appeared to mistakenly feature a Japanese drum, prompting an uproar. The Canadian-headquartered company, known for its upmarket leggings, has been growing rapidly in China and arranged for a yoga festival to take place in late May on a section of the wall near Beijing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 加拿大品牌在为庆祝中国文化而举办的赞助节日上使用太鼓，在中国引起网络轩然大波运动服品牌 Lululemon 在中国长城举行的一次促销活动中错误地使用了日本太鼓，引发轩然大波，该品牌已道歉。这家总部位于加拿大的公司以其高档瑜伽紧身裤而闻名，在中国发展迅速，并于五月底在北京附近的一段长城举办了一场瑜伽节。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This incident reminds us how quickly a seemingly small cultural misstep can ignite widespread public sentiment, especially in the digital age. Just as a tiny spark can set a vast forest ablaze, unintentional actions or symbols can inadvertently cause significant uproar and division. It underscores the need for careful consideration and humility in our...
reflection.zh: 这起事件提醒我们，一个看似微小的文化失误，尤其在数字时代，能多么迅速地引发广泛的公众情绪。正如一点火花能点燃整片森林，无意的行为或象征也可能不经意间造成巨大的争议和分歧。这强调了我们在互动中需要谨慎思考和谦卑，认识到即使是微小的细节也可能产生深远的影响。

verse.textEn: The tongue is a small part of the body, but it makes great boasts. Consider what a great forest is set on fire by a small spark.
verse.textZh: 舌头在百体里也是最小的，却能说大话。看哪，最小的火能点着最大的树林。

title.en: They were forced into marriage and abused. Now women facing exploitation in China have a glimmer of hope
title.zh: 她们被迫结婚并遭受虐待。现在，中国面临剥削的女性有了一线希望

summary.en: Female activists are secretly working to locate and assist vulnerable women in China who have been forced into marriage and subjected to abuse, as they believe authorities are not adequately protecting them.
summary.zh: 在中国，女性活动家们正在秘密寻找并帮助那些被迫结婚并遭受虐待的弱势女性，因为她们担心官方未能提供足够的保护。

summary.en: A new report indicates that global fertility rates are falling faster and spreading further than anticipated, with India's fertility now below the level needed for population stability. This trend means that two-thirds of the world's population now lives in countries with declining birth rates.
summary.zh: 一份新报告指出，全球生育率下降的速度和范围都超出了预期，印度生育率已降至维持人口稳定所需的水平以下。这一趋势意味着全球三分之二的人口生活在生育率下降的国家。

body.en: Indian fertility has fallen below the rate required for population stability, in further evidence of the unexpectedly rapid decline in births internationally The global fall in fertility rates has arrived faster and spread further than anticipated. Two-thirds of people now live in countries that have slipped below the replacement rate – 2.1 births per woman – required for a stable population. Last month, India revealed that its fertility rate had fallen to just 1.9 . The world’s two most populous nations, which pursued cruel and coercive policies to cut births, both face shrinking populations. China’s fertility rate is now around 1, and births last year fell below 8 million – just over half the number projected when the “one child” policy was axed 10 years ago, and comparable to the total in 1738, when its population was 150 million. It’s further proof that what was seen as a phenomenon of rich nations has spread far beyond them. East Asia led the way. title.en: US military plans major war stockpile on Australian soil
title.zh: 美国军方计划在澳大利亚建立大型战争储备

summary.en: The United States military is planning a significant accumulation of weapons on Australian territory. This move is described as a key part of an Asia-wide regional defense strategy aimed at countering the growing influence of China.
summary.zh: 美国军方正计划在澳大利亚领土上大量储备武器。此举被描述为一项旨在对抗中国崛起势力的亚洲区域防御战略的关键组成部分。

body.en:
The US military is planning a permanent war-ready weapons stockpile for its marine corps on Australia's southeast coast beyond the range of most Chinese missiles, tender documents show and officials confirmed to the Agence France-Presse news agency (AFP).

The development of the stockpile, a first for the US marine corps in Australia, comes as the United States is keen to leverage the continent's strategic location in the South Pacific to counter China's rapid military build-up, analysts said.

The US marine corps began global prepositioning of military supplies during the Cold War — using floating stores on ships and caves in Norway where weapons, ammunition and vehicles to sustain thousands of troops are kept.

The first land stockpile in the Asia-Pacific region is expected to open this year in the Philippines, close to potential flashpoints in the South China Sea.

Documents published by the US navy this month show advanced planning for an even larger Australian stockpile, with US$30 million ($42.4M) allocated to build warehouses and offices in southeastern Victoria state for "critical forward provisioning".

The Australian stockpile, expected to reach full capacity by 2028, will be kept in Melbourne before being moved to US warehouses to be constructed next year at an Australian military base at Bandiana in rural Victoria, tender documents show.

Australia does not permit foreign military bases on its soil, a sensitive issue in a country that has a security alliance with the United States and is hosting an increasing variety of US forces on rotation at Australian defence bases.

The US navy is engaging a global defence contractor to employ around 110 engineers, mechanics, material and safety specialists to manage the Australian stockpile, which includes "crew-served weapons", the documents show.

"Marine corps activities in Australia support integrated global sustainment by maintaining ready-for-issue equipment and supplies for operations and exercises across the Indo-Pacific," a US marine corps forces pacific spokesperson told AFP.

The spokesperson declined to comment on contract details or force planning assumptions but said marines' equipment is kept at "high readiness".

Contracting arrangements and the operation of the facility would be made in close coordination with Australia's Department of Defence.

"These activities improve responsiveness, strengthen interoperability with allies and partners, and support a range of missions across the Indo-Pacific," the spokesperson said, using an alternative description for the Asia-Pacific region.

In 2019, Jules was about to be sent on his fourth deployment, this time to Iraq, when he became ill with a rare autoimmune disease.

"I couldn't walk properly. It was like I was drunk", Jules told Insight.

The Army veteran was in hospital for six weeks, where he lost 15kg and had to learn to walk again. 

"And then six weeks after I got out of hospital, I started having seizures, which I'd never had before," Jules said.

His health issues worsened the following year when he lost sight in his right eye after a seizure. 

"Then the doctors finally figured out what was wrong with me, gave me transfusions and the seizures stopped." 

The following week, Jules was in the supermarket with his then girlfriend (now wife) when he bought a Lotto ticket on a whim.

"It was just a sad paradigm insofar as any strange phone calls were not good news — from the preceding couple of years."

He then woke two of his best mates, who also thought at first he was calling with bad news.

"Everyone I told was like, 'Far out, finally some good luck'," he said.

Jules thought about splurging with his winnings — even considering a hair transplant — but decided to be "sensible" and buy a house.

He moved into a new home within 10 days of receiving the Lotto money, which he says was "very grounding".

"There was a lot of uncertainty in my life at the time. I didn't know if I'd ever drive again ...

"The one thing I could say for certain is: 'I've got a house, and I can stay put for however long I want'."

Navigating the journey after a windfall wasn't as smooth for Reggie Sorensen (formerly Reggie Bird).

In 2003, she went from working in a fish and chip shop in Tasmania to becoming a household name after winning $250,000 on the reality show Big Brother. 

She originally went on the show because she wanted a holiday, and winning felt "really bizarre".

title.en: A Melbourne woman lost $646,035 to a romance scam. Should banks and dating apps be forced to refund victims like her?
title.zh: 墨尔本一女子因网络情缘诈骗损失646,035澳元。银行和约会应用是否应被迫赔偿像她这样的受害者？

summary.en: The Albanese government says Australia will have the ‘world’s toughest anti-scam laws’, but consumer advocates fear they’re lacking. A Melbourne woman in her 30s lost $646,035 to a romance scam after meeting a man on Hinge.
summary.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯政府表示，澳大利亚将拥有“世界上最严厉的反诈骗法”，但消费者权益倡导者担心这些法律仍有不足。墨尔本一名30多岁的女性在Hinge上认识一名男子后，因网络情缘诈骗损失了646,035澳元。

body.en:
On his Hinge profile, the man had a “nice smile”, says Jane*, a Melbourne woman in her 30s. When they matched in May 2025, she thought he seemed like “just generally a nice person”.

By the time Jane, who has autism and a learning disability, realised she was being scammed, she had sent $646,035 to the man she had fallen in love with. The man is believed to have used a fake name but the Guardian is calling him Joe.

A couple of months before Jane started talking to Joe, the Albanese government passed what it described as the “world’s toughest anti-scam laws” . But the laws will not be functional until 2027 and consumer advocates don’t expect them to apply to dating apps even though they consider them a vector for scams.

Jane’s bank won’t refund her the money. Earlier this year, when she challenged the decision at the Australian Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA), it sided with the bank.

“It makes me really sad, and my mum,” Jane says. She cries when she talks about learning the British passport Joe showed her was fake, and when she discloses the total sum of her crushing financial loss.

Jane isn’t alone in her devastation: in the past 18 months, Australians have lost more than $37m in the 4,767 romance scams reported to authorities. Like Jane’s, most of them began online.

The day after they started talking on Hinge, Joe asked Jane to move the conversation on to WhatsApp. Their messages, seen by Guardian Australia, show how she was manipulated. After she confided in him that she’d never been in a relationship, even though she’d always deeply desired one, he said: “So I will be the first person you ever fall in love with.”

Joe claimed to be a Fifo worker who would move to Melbourne when his contract was up. He told her he saw a future with her that involved cooking for her, an overseas honeymoon and children. He told her he loved her.

He also told her he needed money. He said it was an emergency, that he needed work equipment and he would pay her back with 50% interest.

“I thought that I could really trust him,” Jane says. “He said, ‘I’m not the kind of bad person that would do this.’”

Dr Kate Gould, a senior researcher and neuropsychologist at Monash University, says humans have a “basic need” for love and connection, which means “we are very open to someone’s interest in us”.

Gould says even though romance scams are very emotionally destructive, dating platforms have a very difficult task in trying to vet who’s genuine and who’s not.

But, she says, “as a society, we would want them to be really focused on trying to ensure that anyone they offer through their dating platforms is a real person and not a criminal who’s trying to emotionally and financially harm us”.

title.en: 'History not positive': Albanese warns of leaders spill amid Keir Starmer resignation reports
title.zh: “历史并不乐观”：阿尔巴尼斯就基尔·斯塔默辞职传闻警告领导人更迭

summary.en: Albanese says he will deal with whoever is in power as pressure mounts on Keir Starmer's leadership.

body.en:
Australia's Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has warned against a leadership change in the United Kingdom amid reports his British Labour counterpart Keir Starmer could be about to resign.

Britain's Observer newspaper is reporting Starmer is expected to resign on Monday and set out a timetable for his departure.

The Observer report, which did not name its sources, said Starmer had reached the conclusion that his position was no longer tenable after speaking to cabinet ministers, advisers, donors and trade union leaders.

However, a government source said Starmer remained focused on getting on with the job of governing.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Asked about the potential change by Sky News on Sunday morning, Albanese said he will "deal with whoever is elected".

"But I must say that the history of just changing leaders is not a positive one," he said. "I've dealt with already four British prime ministers since I've been elected as prime minister."

Speculation of Starmer's retirement has been building for months and has accelerated since Friday, when his rival Andy Burnham won more than 50 per cent of the vote in the Makerfield byelection, officially allowing him to now launch a formal leadership challenge.

Burnham, the 56-year-old mayor of Greater Manchester, is widely seen as Starmer's most likely successor, whether through a negotiated transfer of power or a formal leadership contest.

He used his victory speech to promise a new path for the United Kingdom, rather than launching an immediate formal challenge.

Starmer said on Friday he would fight any challenge to his leadership and urged Labour not to tear itself apart with infighting.

Starmer led the centre-left Labour party to a landslide election win in 2024, but became deeply unpopular after a series of scandals, policy U-turns and local election defeats.

More than 100 elected lawmakers in Starmer's party - roughly a quarter of all Labour representatives in the House of Commons - have publicly said they want him to quit or set out a timetable for his exit, according to a Reuters tally.

If he were to quit or be ousted, it would be the United Kingdom's seventh prime minister in just over a decade — the highest turnover in nearly two centuries.

Albanese has previously backed Starmer's leadership, in May saying: "He is a friend of mine, and I hope that Keir Starmer continues to serve as prime minister of the United Kingdom", and warning that the, "revolving door of leaders does not lead to stability".

body.en:
Lynne Meehan’s 91-year-old dad, John Wilson, was diagnosed with sepsis last September.

That was the start of the family’s frustrating experience with accessing the aged care system.

"I worked in intensive care for 28 years and have never seen anything so complicated or so difficult," Meehan, 57, said.

They then put their findings into an algorithm, and an outcome is provided automatically, with how much funding support the person gets, and a priority level.

"I said, look, Dad, I know you can't fight, but I will fight for you to get this package'.

"Because he was pretty resigned to the fact that he'd be gone before he got anything," Meehan said.

"It's really important that he (was provided with a device with) one button to push that he would know would get him some sort of outside attention if he needed it."

Her parents used their part-pension instead and were out of pocket $2,000 to install a ramp and rent a fall monitor.

summary.en: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese announced an extension of the fuel excise cut, acknowledging that Australians continue to face economic pressure.

body.en:
Cost relief at the bowser has been extended for another month, although the savings won't be as substantial.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has announced a limited extension of the fuel excise, making petrol and diesel 16 cents per litre cheaper than the full price in July.

The current saving is 32 cents a litre after it was cut three months ago, following the outbreak of war in the Middle East and ensuing strangulation of global oil supplies.

That discount is scheduled to expire on 30 June, by which time it will have cost the federal budget an estimated $2.9 billion in foregone revenue.

Speaking to Sky News on Sunday morning, Albanese said the decision to halve rather than scrap the discount was about giving motorists and businesses some certainty.

"We know that families are still under pressure, and we also know that the impact of this conflict on the other side of the world will have a long economic tail to it," Albanese told Sky News.

"There's still some uncertainty that oil prices come down this week. We want to see that flow through, but it will take some time."

"This will enable some certainty going forward, and for confidence to remain in the system."

"We'll continue to do what we can to shield Australians from the worst impacts of this conflict, including securing additional fuel from our partners."

Albanese said a "step down", rather than a full removal of the excise was the "sensible thing to do".

States and territories — who have effectively funded their share of the scheme by forgoing a GST windfall gain over the last three months— are expected to come on board with the excise extension.

Treasurer Jim Chalmers said he hoped the temporary support would still take some of the sting out of petrol prices and help with the cost of living.

"Despite the welcome and substantial drop in the price of petrol recently, we recognise people are still under pressure," he said.

"This extra month of fuel discount will help Australian motorists and businesses with the cost of living as this support tapers off."

Pressed on whether further extensions were possible should the US-Iran deal collapse, Albanese stopped short of guaranteeing anything.

"We do live in a volatile world, so were there to be a massive global shock again, my government will always respond," he said.

He also pointed to broader cost-of-living measures landing on 1 July, noting "every Australian worker will get a tax cut" as further relief arriving alongside the reduced fuel discount.
